memory.bounds: Validate offset+length without wrap, all output spans and overlap before any native effect; no native address crosses ABI

errors.11: no fresh state yet; no implicit retry
errors.90: output too small; required length only, no truncation or submit side effect
errors.110: deadline; command may be indeterminate, never replay
errors.116: stale mapping/policy/sample epoch; reject before effect

rules: open resolves only explicit alias robot in this caller Instance, backend adapter and policy; returns a nonzero generation only on success
Each call validates exact contract, caller/module provenance, owner, grants, state freshness and mapping epoch; descriptors never create permissions
describe and state failures never expose unowned data; length_out is written only on success or size-error 90
submit validates complete command and output capacity before effect; accepts one unique command_id per owner generation; duplicate command_id is refused, not replayed
Native goal acceptance is not completion. SUCCEEDED requires a real native result or explicitly declared equivalent plus fresh observed state within tolerance
wait has a policy-configured finite deadline no greater than 2000ms, never a native callback into Wasm and never a hidden resubmission
close retires exactly this owner, does not cancel/replay an uncertain command, and remains caller-owned cleanup after revocation
Mapping or permission updates invalidate old epochs/handles. Cache, debug, rollback and hot update cannot add or restore permissions
This preview requires a new VM-host implementation by the VM owner. It is not a binding already supported by native21
